banner.title: unpoller
banner.tagline: Polls the UniFi controller's API every two minutes and exposes its clients, ports and devices as Prometheus metrics.

explainer.title: From a UniFi poll to a Prometheus series

steps.title: Key
steps.text: ExternalSecret unpoller reads 1Password item unifi and renders the controller URL and API key into unpoller-secret.
steps.scene: a key drawn from a vault

steps.title: Poll
steps.text: The pod calls the UniFi API with that key, as role home-ops, and reads the controller's current state.
steps.scene: a radar pulse reaching a router

steps.title: Convert
steps.text: Each poll becomes Prometheus series on port 80. The ServiceMonitor scrapes /metrics every two minutes.
steps.scene: poll results turning into a line chart

steps.title: Stay
steps.text: Runs as UID 1000 with a read-only root filesystem and every capability dropped. The startup probe allows 30 checks, five seconds apart.
steps.scene: a container shell with a padlock
